facetDefinitionAdditions.hybrid-layout: Qualification deliberately combines represented meld/pair groups with loose tiles rather than using either a complete ordinary four-melds-plus-pair decomposition or a wholly loose irregular collection.

reason: The second batch exposed a useful third structural presentation shape. Windy Ones/Nines/Chow and Dragonfly combine loose honour tiles with represented groups, so classifying them as ordinary grouped or wholly irregular would mis-teach the hand structure.
